prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-realistic casual indoor selfie in soft natural daylight.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with long wavy brunette hair swept to one side, clear blue eyes, defined brows, subtle natural makeup, light freckles, relaxed confident expression, fitted ribbed burgundy long-sleeve top, delicate beaded necklace, and small drop earrings.
prompt.composition_elements: Casual head-and-shoulders selfie with slightly tilted head, cozy minimal bedroom, white walls and door, shallow depth of field, natural candid framing.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft daylight from a nearby window, cinematic gentle lighting, realistic color grading and skin texture, calm cozy mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic DSLR-quality smartphone portrait, 50mm lens look, natural depth of field, realistic skin and fabric texture.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ultra-realistic portrait of an approved adult woman taking a casual indoor selfie in soft natural daylight. She has long wavy brunette hair swept to one side, clear blue eyes, defined brows, subtle natural makeup, light freckles, and a relaxed confident expression. She wears a fitted ribbed burgundy long-sleeve top with a delicate beaded necklace and small drop earrings. Use a cozy minimal bedroom with white walls and a door, slightly tilted head, shallow depth of field, cinematic soft lighting, 50mm lens look, high-detail natural skin texture, realistic color grading, and candid social-media framing.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, lingerie, transparent fabric, deep neckline, sexualized pose, nudity, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, text, logo, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required approved-adult reference. Preserve face, identity, hair, eyes, freckles, burgundy wardrobe, jewelry, bedroom, and soft daylight; identity may be replaced by another approved adult. No typography or logo is required.
